purpose: Make Character Design Sheet 01-04 composition a strict child of the single production character prompt exporter so a sheet can never bypass current identity, garment, color, world, acting, fidelity, spatial, layout, maintenance, occlusion or crop-readability authority.

observedLatestMain.note: This SHA records the synchronization baseline, not a permanent authority freeze. A newer main must be rechecked before generation or merge.

existingInventoryPacket.reason: Static packets can become stale whenever main adds production authority. The live Sheet Adapter resolves the current top-level Production Exporter on every export.

hold.reason: User explicitly put Yui production aside after Sheet 01 attempt 01 rejection. Keep all rejected history/lineage, but do not regenerate Yui or advance Sheet 02-04 while this hold remains active.

latestInheritedAuthorities.rule: Solve overlap by camera/crop, authorized placement, physical deformation, omission of hidden micro-detail or Human review; never redesign construction to remove collisions.
Adapt composition before sacrificing identity-bearing silhouette, species, prop, mobility, ground-contact or construction information.

identity-turnaround: no mirror substitution for asymmetric construction
neutral inspection pose does not create signature pose
do not hide unresolved overlap or construction behind crop
face-expression-acting: neutral base face remains parent geometry
expression deforms soft tissue rather than identity geometry
diagnostic acting does not create signature emotional canon
crop/effects may not erase identity-bearing face/head construction
costume-equipment-material: authorized garment construction and storage only
Named Object geometry remains separate authority
solve layer collisions without deleting or rerouting garment/equipment construction
silhouette-motion-derivation: body mass/species/age/mobility identity survives motion and perspective
world adapts around the character rather than resizing the character
OPEN motion uses neutral diagnostic placeholders rather than signature choreography
crop and effects preserve identity-bearing silhouette information
